facts.text: Under the Ferris Pledge, incoming first-year Michigan residents eligible for a Pell Grant have their full tuition and required fees covered by scholarships and grants.

sources.title: Ferris Pledge | Zero Out-of-Pocket Expenses | Ferris State University

facts.text: The Ferris Pledge covers the full cost of tuition and required fees by combining federal and state scholarships and grants with institutional financial aid.
